name: Apify
description: Read public social posts, comments, engagers and channel stats through a fixed set of Apify actors.

methods.whenToUse: Use the company's own Apify API token to read public social posts, comments, engagers and channel stats.
methods.guidanceMd: In Apify Console, open Settings → API & Integrations, create an API token for Paperclip, and paste it below. Every actor run bills your Apify account per result. This card connects a fixed list of social-reading actors, so agents cannot run any other actor. On the Permissions screen, turn off the actors for channels you do not use.
methods.label: Use an Apify API token (social reading actors)

credentialFields.label: Apify API token
credentialFields.helperMd: Create a token under Console → Settings → API & Integrations. A standard token acts for the whole Apify account. You can turn on Limit token permissions to scope it to running these actors and reading the storage their runs create; a scoped token was not tested with the MCP server. Every run bills the account per result.

warnings: Each actor run bills the company's Apify account per result. Set an Apify usage limit, and have the operator apply the Apify governance policies (a daily cap on actor runs; run control and store reads blocked) before agents run unattended.
The fixed actor list prevents running other actors. Turn off the actors for unused channels on the Permissions screen.
